sources.claim: Christine (Costa Mesa Doula) publishes a $1,500 birth package with prenatal, labor, and postpartum support
sources.quote: Christine is a birth doula based in Costa Mesa whose published birth package is $1,500 and includes two prenatal visits, 24/7 phone and text access, continuous labor support, and one postpartum visit.

sources.claim: Tiffany Blackham is an IDI-certified birth and postpartum doula in Costa Mesa with HypnoBirthing and placenta credentials
sources.quote: Certification and training: IDI- Certified Birth Doula (2017); HypnoBirthing International Educator Certification (2022); HypnoBabies Certified Doula (2020); IPPA, Certified Placenta Specialist (2020)

sources.claim: Tessa Fisher (Abundant Blessings Midwifery) is a Licensed Midwife / CPM offering home and water birth in Orange County
sources.quote: Tessa Fisher is a licensed midwife and certified professional midwife who runs Abundant Blessings Midwifery, a community-based home birth practice serving Orange County including Costa Mesa.

sources.claim: Kellie Gwaltney, CNM is a certified nurse-midwife at 3400 Avenue of the Arts, Costa Mesa (NPI 1013315563)
sources.quote: Kellie Gwaltney is a certified nurse-midwife practicing in Costa Mesa, listed with NPI 1013315563 at 3400 Avenue of the Arts. Her practice provides midwifery care in a personalized environment.

sources.claim: Hoag Hospital Newport Beach Sue & Bill Gross Women's Pavilion has a 33-bed Level III NICU and private LDR suites
sources.quote: The Women's Pavilion at Hoag Hospital Newport Beach includes: an expanded Level III NICU with 33 beds; 18 private labor, delivery, and recovery suites; 49 private postpartum rooms.

sources.claim: MemorialCare Orange Coast Medical Center is the only Orange County community hospital with certified nurse midwives on staff
sources.quote: MemorialCare Orange Coast Medical Center's Childbirth Center in Fountain Valley is the only community hospital program in Orange County with certified nurse midwives on its medical staff.
